subject: Re: Signal instrumentation plan for GreenHarvest — dashboards, tracing, alerts
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Patel <aisha@greenharvest.tech>, ops@greenharvest.tech
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 Jan 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Signal instrumentation kickoff — dashboards, tracing hooks, runbooks

Hi Aisha / GreenHarvest ops team,

Thanks again for the productive workshop last week. Attached is a first-pass "Signal Instrumentation Matrix" that maps the top 12 operational signals we recommend for your platform: request latencies, inference tail-latency percentiles, model cache hit rate, tokenization errors, request/response sampling for traces, rate-limited errors, auth failures, billing-metering deltas, and a short list of business-metric anchors.

What we're proposing for the first sprint (2 weeks):
- Baseline dashboards: Grafana + Redwood Console panels for P95/P99 latency, throughput, and error-rate by route.
- Tracing hooks: lightweight capture on request ingress, model call boundaries, and KV-cache misses (sampling 1% initially; adjust after review).
- Error taxonomy: triage categories and suggested alert thresholds (see tab 3 of the spreadsheet).
- Alert routing & runbooks: route actionable alerts to PagerDuty (GH-Platform) and Slack (#gh-alerts), with runbook templates for common incidents.

Attachments: [Attachment: signal-instrumentation-matrix.xlsx (xlsx, 42KB)]
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-greenharvest-instrumentation

Proposed kickoff sync: Thursday 2028-01-13 10:00 PT (30m). If that works, we'll assign owners and open the epic in your tracker.

Next steps for GreenHarvest ops team: 1) confirm access to Redwood Console dashboards or invite (project: greenharvest-prod), 2) confirm PagerDuty service name for alert routing, 3) flag any PII/sampling constraints for traces.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
[Attachment: runbook-template.md (md, 6KB)]
From: Aisha Patel <aisha@greenharvest.tech>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 Jan 2028 08:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Signal instrumentation kickoff — dashboards, tracing hooks, runbooks

Hi Marissa — thanks for sending. This matrix looks useful. A few quick notes from our security/compliance side:

- Tracing: we cannot store any raw user input in traces. Sampling is fine, but all payloads must be redacted before persistence. We use GCP KMS for key management and will ask for the exact retention window.
- Dashboards: read-only access for our infra team is preferred; we can grant Redwood an administrative project role for the short rollout.
- PagerDuty: our service is called "GH-Platform" and the escalation policy is the on-call platform engineer first, then platform lead.

I can join the Thursday slot if it stays at 10:00 PT. Also please include a short column in the matrix for compliance notes (redaction required / allowed sampling).

Thanks,
Aisha Patel
Platform Engineering Lead
GreenHarvest
[external attachment: gh-infra-overview.pdf (pdf, 120KB)]
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 13 Jan 2028 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Signal instrumentation kickoff — dashboards, tracing hooks, runbooks

Hi Aisha — appreciate the compliance callouts, noted. A few clarifications from the implementation side and owners: 

- Tracing hooks owner: Ben Carter (instrumentation lead) — Ben will deliver a short spec for redaction rules and sampling by EOD Monday 2028-01-16. We will only record derived/request-metadata (no raw user text) and will add a required field column in the matrix indicating "redaction required".
- Dashboards owner: Laura Bennett (observability engineer) — Laura will provision the Redwood Console read-only link for GH and push an initial set of panels to the proposal dashboard by 2028-01-17. Panels will include route-level P95/P99, request rates, and error classification buckets.
- Runbooks & alerts: Marissa will centralize runbook drafts in the Drive folder. We will wire alerts to PagerDuty service GH-Platform and to Slack #gh-alerts. Thresholds: initial P99 > 750ms for page, error-rate > 0.5% for 5m window (tunable).

Action items (owners + target):
1) Ben: redaction + sampling spec (2028-01-16)
2) Laura: dashboard links + JSON export (2028-01-17)
3) Marissa: consolidated runbook draft + incident play examples (2028-01-18)
4) Aisha: confirm data retention & KMS constraints (2028-01-16)

We'll review these in our kickoff Thursday 10:00 PT (calendar invite sent). If anything needs to be moved earlier, ping me.

—Markus
Markus Klein
Director, Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference

Thanks everyone — quick summary from today's kickoff and agreed next steps: 

Decisions made:
- Traces: sample 1% with PII redaction; no raw user text persisted. Ben to deliver spec and redaction checklist.
- Dashboards: Laura to publish initial dashboard JSON to Drive and Redwood Console (read-only) by 2028-01-17 (delivered).
- Alerts: route to PagerDuty service GH-Platform; initial thresholds set (P99 750ms, error-rate 0.5% over 5m).
- Runbooks: using standard template attached; we'll publish incident examples for model-cache storms and tokenization errors.

Attachments consolidated in Drive:
- signal-instrumentation-matrix.xlsx
- runbook-template.md
- dashboards-proposal.json

Scheduled follow-ups:

- Laura: confirm dashboard link in Redwood Console (done).
- Marissa: open GH epic in Jira and populate epic with action cards (2028-01-19).

If there are any missed items, reply-all and I'll update the Drive sheet and the epic. Thanks for the smooth kickoff — looking forward to the first rollout.
